programs.desc: The East second round commences as the Flyers face the Hurricanes at Lenovo Center for Game 1. Taylor Hall leads the Hurricanes with seven points, while Rasmus Ristolainen leads the Flyers with five points in the Stanley Cup Playoffs.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Flyers play the Hurricanes in Game 2 of the East second round at Lenovo Center. Carolina dominated the opener, with Logan Stankoven extending his playoff goal streak to five games by scoring twice, including the opening goal 90 seconds in.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Hurricanes take on the Flyers in Game 3 of the East second round at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Carolina leads 2-0. Frederik Andersen made 34 saves, while Dan Vladar stopped 40 shots in a losing effort. Taylor Hall scored the deciding goal.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Hurricanes play the Flyers in Game 4 of the East second round at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Carolina leads 3-0. In Game 3, Carolina fueled its victory with goals from Jordan Staal and Jalen Chatfield. Andrei Svechnikov scored his first playoff goal.
